SELECT a.assignment_id, a.emp_id, a.company_id, a.contract_start_date, a.contract_end_date, a.unit_price, a.role_id, a.delete_flg, a.created_at, a.updated_at, e.last_name, e.first_name, e.last_name_kana, e.first_name_kana, e.engineer_type, c.company_name AS assign_company_name, ec.company_id AS ec_company_id, ec.company_name AS emp_company_name, ec.company_name_kana AS emp_company_name_kana, r.role FROM t_assignment a INNER JOIN m_employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN m_company c ON a.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN m_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id INNER JOIN m_role r ON a.role_id = r.role_id WHERE a.assignment_id = #{id} AND a.delete_flg = 0 AND e.delete_flg = 0 AND c.delete_flg = 0 AND ec.delete_flg = 0
